name: skills-catalog
description: Production-grade Agent Skills Monorepo compatible with Antigravity 2.x, Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex following the open Agent Skills standard.

skills.name: brd
skills.description: Autonomous Principal Product Owner skill for Antigravity 2.x, Claude Code, and Codex that transforms raw concepts into verified, pure Business Requirements Documents (BRD.md) using CoT, ToT, and ReAct critique loops.

scopes.description: Supports calibrating requirements to Minimal (lightweight throwaway), Prototype (feasibility), MVP (Day-1 production release), or Full (enterprise multi-phase platform) boundaries.

context_optimization.description: Progressively loads schemas on-demand, leverages subagents for isolated validation runs, and uses line-slicing for document refinement to maintain optimal context window utilization.

reasoning_tier.description: High-complexity cognitive tasks: CoT persona elicitation, ToT domain decomposition, use case synthesis, ReAct self-critique

lightweight_tier.description: Low-cost/fast trivial tasks: linter execution, validation checks, formatting, minor text fixes, metadata audits

skills.name: robinhood
skills.description: Find official direct links and access options for ebooks, movies, videos, audio, music, papers, and other named resources.

scopes.description: Supports quick, standard, and deep direct-link and access searches for named books, media, papers, and other resources.

context_optimization.description: Keeps the skill entrypoint concise and loads the source guide only for nuanced or multi-format direct-link and resource lookups.

reasoning_tier.description: Resource disambiguation, direct-link validation, multi-source comparison, and nuanced access synthesis

lightweight_tier.description: Simple metadata formatting, checklist application, and short access summaries

skills.name: req-nfr-analysis
skills.description: Phase 1 requirements analysis skill that normalizes functional requirements, extracts and tags every requirement across 19 NFR categories, flags inferred NFRs, and prioritizes each as hard constraint vs nice-to-have for downstream architecture/design phases.

scopes.description: Supports quick (5 key NFRs), standard (all 19 NFRs + 10-15 questions), and thorough (complete analysis + dependency reasoning) analysis depths.

context_optimization.description: Progressively loads reference taxonomy and gap patterns on-demand; inlines only 19 category names in core skill body to maintain optimal context utilization.

reasoning_tier.description: Systematic requirement extraction, NFR categorization, gap pattern matching, priority reasoning, and stakeholder question synthesis

lightweight_tier.description: Formatting, table synthesis, reference citation, and output validation

skills.name: architecture-decisions
skills.description: Phase 2 architecture decisioning skill that evaluates architecture styles (monolith, modular monolith, microservices, event-driven, serverless) and agentic-AI fitness (fit/partial-fit/not-fit) using hard constraints from req-nfr-analysis.md input, surfaces 1-2 alternatives at checkpoint, and produces MADR-formatted ADRs for both decisions with documented rationale. Mandatory checkpoint before lock-in.

scopes.description: Supports quick (1 alternative + informal reasoning), standard (2 alternatives + rationale table), and thorough (3-style scoring matrix + cross-decision dependency analysis) evaluation depths.

context_optimization.description: Progressively loads architecture style criteria and agentic-AI fitness dimensions on-demand; inlines only style/dimension names in core skill body to maintain optimal context utilization.

reasoning_tier.description: Multi-criteria scoring, architecture trade-off analysis, agentic-AI dimension evaluation, cross-dependency reasoning, ADR rationale synthesis

lightweight_tier.description: Markdown ADR formatting, table structuring, reference citation, and output validation
